name: dev-cisco-reference-bare

irregularities.statement: e.g. tacacs server TACACS > address ipv4 192.0.2.10

irregularities.what: the server group LAB-TACACS: server name TACACS
irregularities.statement: aaa group server tacacs+ LAB-TACACS > server name TACACS
aaa authentication login default local group LAB-TACACS

irregularities.what: the console's own login list CONSOLE (local only, so a local user always gets in there)
the default exec authorization list (without it every new login lands at privilege 1)
irregularities.statement: aaa authorization exec default local group LAB-TACACS if-authenticated
e.g. aaa accounting exec default start-stop group LAB-TACACS

irregularities.what: the accounting session id is common
the login method of line con 0: login authentication CONSOLE
the login method of line vty 0 15: login authentication default (the device has: the login method of line vty 0 4: login local)

irregularities.statement: e.g. aaa authorization commands 1 default local group LAB-TACACS
irregularities.action: command authorization is not in this paste: log in on a new session with your own account and check 'show privilege', then plan again; it is the one group of lines left.

irregularities.statement: e.g. ip access-list standard TACCTL-SNMP > permit 192.0.2.10

irregularities.what: the SNMP location is Rack 4, DC1

irregularities.statement: e.g. ip access-list standard VTY-ACL > permit 192.0.2.10

irregularities.what: the access-class binding of line vty 0 15
irregularities.action: Left to you: the walkthrough's access-class line is never part of this output.

region: ! aaa: the server, the group and the method lists tacctl renders
aaa authentication login default local group LAB-TACACS
aaa authorization exec default local group LAB-TACACS if-authenticated
aaa accounting exec default start-stop group LAB-TACACS
aaa accounting commands 1 default start-stop group LAB-TACACS
aaa accounting commands 5 default start-stop group LAB-TACACS
aaa accounting commands 7 default start-stop group LAB-TACACS
aaa accounting commands 15 default start-stop group LAB-TACACS
! roles: the privilege lines of the levels tacctl renders
! snmp: the community tacctl renders, retyped as rendered
! mgmt-acl: the management access list tacctl renders (its entries and their order)
! aaa: the login method of the console and vty lines
after: ! If any line printed "% Invalid" or "% Error", stop and undo it: tacctl device config plan
! dev-cisco-reference-bare --backout (its own region, to paste in the second terminal).
! Check now (nothing rolls this back by itself):
!   From the tacctl server:   tacctl device config pull dev-cisco-reference-bare --diff     (aaa, roles, snmp and mgmt-acl: ok)
!   In the second terminal:   open a NEW ssh session to dev-cisco-reference-bare as yourself, then: terminal length 0, show privilege (must say 15)
! When both checks are fine, type this one command yourself:  write memory
! To undo: tacctl device config plan dev-cisco-reference-bare --backout (tacctl keeps this plan's
! back-out: after the check pull has replaced the picture, the command still prints this plan's,
! and says which pull it undoes, until the next plan with changes)
! Do not: 'write memory' before the check; paste outside the banners; paste into another device;
! paste on a console more than twenty lines at a time; keep this output in a file after the paste
! Locked out (the paste cut your session and no login works)? A superuser runs: tacctl breakglass hold dev-cisco-reference-bare --reason "..."
! then log in as the device's local account (console: local login, then 'enable' with the local secret),
! fix or back out, and the superuser runs: tacctl breakglass release dev-cisco-reference-bare
backout: ! back-out: the lines as the pull showed them
! VALUE NEEDED, then remove this mark: no snmp-server community <SECRET>
no privilege exec level 7 undebug all
no privilege exec level 1 show running-config
! (on IOS 15.x a removed privilege line may stay as 'privilege exec level <default> <cmd>'
! ('no aaa new-model' drops every aaa line but does not restore the login method of the lines: the line vty and line con lines of this back-out do)
withheld: command authorization, held back until the server is proven: aaa authorization commands 1 default local group LAB-TACACS
command authorization, held back until the server is proven: aaa authorization commands 7 default local group LAB-TACACS
command authorization, held back until the server is proven: aaa authorization commands 15 default local group LAB-TACACS
command authorization, held back until the server is proven: aaa authorization config-commands
the login method of lines the record does not show: line vty 0 15 > login authentication default
the access-class binding: line vty 0 15 > access-class VTY-ACL in
